```{python}
import os, glob, base64
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import HTML, display

dataset = params.get("dataset", "viral_analysis")
has_selection = str(params.get("has_selection", "false")).lower() == "true"
has_haplotype = str(params.get("has_haplotype", "false")).lower() == "true"

def embed_image(path):
    if os.path.exists(path):
        with open(path, "rb") as image_file:
            encoded_string = base64.b64encode(image_file.read()).decode('utf-8')
        return f'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{encoded_string}" style="max-width:100%; height:auto; border:1px solid #ddd; border-radius:6px; margin: 15px 0;"/>'
    return "<p><em>Plot unavailable</em></p>"
```

## Statistical & Methodological Framework

- **Allele Frequency Units:** Machine VCF/TSV outputs record proportions ($0–1$). Displayed frequencies in tables and figures represent percentages ($100 \times \text{proportion}$) with explicit `%` units.
- **Frequency Tiering & Corroboration Rules:**
  - **Confirmed Minor Variants ($\ge 1.0\%$):** Reported with high confidence.
  - **Candidate iSNVs ($0.1\% - 1.0\%$):** Quality-model driven. Requires (1) LoFreq Poisson-binomial significance ($p < 0.01$), (2) strand-balance filter pass, and (3) $\ge 10$ ALT observations (requires coverage depth $\ge 10,000\times$).
  - **Exploratory Variants ($< 0.1\%$):** At or below single-base Q30 sequencing noise floor ($\epsilon \approx 0.1\%$).
- **Indel Analysis Scope:** LoFreq runs SNV-focused by default (`lofreq_enable_indelqual = false`); unqualified indels are filtered out by `--indelqual-thresh 20`.

# Software Provenance

Collated software versions utilized during this workflow run.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| results: 'asis'

ver_file = "software_versions.yml"
if os.path.exists(ver_file):
    import yaml
    with open(ver_file, 'r') as f:
        ver_data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}
    rows = ""
    for proc, tools in sorted(ver_data.items()):
        if isinstance(tools, dict):
            for tool, ver in sorted(tools.items()):
                rows += f"<tr><td>{proc}</td><td>{tool}</td><td>{ver}</td></tr>"
    html_ver = f'<table class="table table-sm"><thead><tr><th>Process</th><th>Tool</th><th>Version</th></tr></thead><tbody>{rows}</tbody></table>'
    display(HTML(html_ver))
```
